name: GigaHack
_comment: Load order is significant: later modules depend on earlier ones. The installer writes these entries into js/plugins.js in this order, at the end, so every GigaHack alias is outermost. The test harness reads the same list.

modules.name: GigaHack_Core
modules.description: namespace, safe-call, hook registry, layout and paths

modules.name: GigaHack_Caps
modules.description: engine detection, capability table, MV/MZ adapters

modules.name: GigaHack_Store
modules.description: settings, undo, backups; fs then localStorage then memory

modules.name: GigaHack_Hooks
modules.description: every engine alias, pause and single-step

modules.name: GigaHack_Tabs
modules.description: tab and panel registry, Debug panels

modules.name: GigaHack_Compat
modules.description: load order, self-tests, write-verify, alias integrity

modules.name: GigaHack_Save
modules.description: save anywhere, quick save and load

modules.name: GigaHack_Trace
modules.description: watchpoints, the change journal, running interpreters, RNG

modules.name: GigaHack_Snapshot
modules.description: state snapshots: what changed since the save, and between two saves

modules.name: GigaHack_Quest
modules.description: why an event is locked, common events, reconstructed objectives, the script dump

modules.name: GigaHack_Media
modules.description: the audio the game ships, its image folders, and screenshots

modules.name: GigaHack_Screen
modules.description: tint, weather, zoom, shake, the picture slots, window transparency

modules.name: GigaHack_Auto
modules.description: run something when the game reaches a state; run splits

modules.name: GigaHack_Kit
modules.description: equipment loadouts and an ad-hoc shop

modules.name: GigaHack_Keys
modules.description: the key map the game itself reads

modules.name: GigaHack_Build
modules.description: what this build costs to run, and how its plugins are configured
